data.description:
hostedInspectorDividerHit(at:) runs from hitTest() on EVERY pointer event and, per browser slot, recursively walks the slot's entire view tree (Self.visibleDescendants) looking for inspector divider candidates - BrowserWindowPortal.swift:840-927, visibleDescendants at :1129-1137. Cost is O(N slots x tree depth) per event; with several browsers + DevTools attached (20-50+ descendants each) this contributes to pointer/typing lag.

Corroborating: the 2026-06-11 CPU diag (c11_2026-06-11-135049_Hyperion.cpu_resource.diag) shows WindowTerminalHostView.dividerCursorKind(at:in:) / updateDividerCursor(at:) burning samples from cursorUpdate(with:) - the same per-event divider-scan genre on the terminal side.

Also: BrowserWindowHostView.layout() calls reapplyHostedInspectorDividerIfNeeded() for ALL visible slots on every layout pass (BrowserWindowPortal.swift:361-369), each triggering the same descendant scan.

FIX SHAPE
- Cache divider candidates per slot, invalidated on view-hierarchy change (or on inspector attach/detach), instead of rescanning per event.
- Early-exit the descendant walk once a candidate is found.
- Mirror the discipline already documented for WindowTerminalHostView.hitTest() (pointer-event gating; see CLAUDE.md typing-latency pitfalls).

Related: C11-132 (browser portal geometry feedback loop) - same multi-browser freeze investigation, independent deliverable.
data.title: Hosted-inspector divider hit-test: cache/early-exit the per-event view-tree scan

data.body: Implementation in progress on stacked branch fix/c11-133-inspector-divider-hit-test (off PR #237's branch). Changes: (1) pointer-event gating in WindowBrowserHostView.hitTest mirroring the terminal host view; (2) fixed the updateDividerCursor contract — caller-computed nil no longer triggers a re-scan (the old 'hit ?? rescan' double-scanned every pointer event in the no-inspector case); (3) per-slot candidate cache with negative-result caching, invalidated on slot didAddSubview/willRemoveSubview (docked DevTools attach as direct slot children), slot layout, and the reapply paths, with cheap positive-hit revalidation; (4) descendant walk now collects only inspector candidates and prunes matched subtrees (nested WKInspector views resolve to the same top-level hit via the upward walk).

PR open: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/238 (branch fix/c11-133-inspector-divider-hit-test, stacked on PR #237's branch — merge #237 first). Validation: c11-logic 911/911; tagged-build pointer-storm — 120 real HID pointer moves across 4 browser panes after forced cache invalidation produced EXACTLY 4 browser.inspectorScan events (one per slot) then silence; pre-change the same sweep cost ~2 full tree scans per event (~240). DevTools-toggle churn re-scanned each slot exactly once. HONEST GAP: attached-inspector divider drag could not be manually re-validated — on this WebKit build DevTools opens detached for portal-hosted webviews even via c11's first-reveal attach() SPI (verified twice with fresh panels), so the manual-divider path is dormant on current WebKit; the candidate-scan logic is unchanged and reapply paths force-rescan. Evidence archived in-branch at notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/c11-133-pointer-storm-validation.log.

E2E validation evidence (tagged build c11-133, C11_PORTAL_DEBUG=1, 4 browser panes): 120 real HID pointer moves swept across all 4 panes AFTER forced cache invalidation (workspace switch away+back) -> exactly 4 browser.inspectorScan events, one per slot, then silence; pre-change the same sweep cost ~2 full descendant-tree scans per pointer event (~240). DevTools-toggle hierarchy churn re-scanned each affected slot exactly once (invalidation works). Recorded gap: attached-inspector divider drag not manually re-validated — DevTools opens DETACHED for portal-hosted webviews on this WebKit build even via c11's first-reveal attach() SPI (two fresh-panel attempts), so the manual-divider path is dormant on current WebKit; candidate-scan logic unchanged, reapply paths force-rescan. Adjacent bug filed as C11-135. Artifact in-branch: notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/c11-133-pointer-storm-validation.log. REBASE NOTE: restacked onto the rebased PR #237 branch after C11-134 landed; clean. c11-logic post-rebase: 907/911 + 1 load-sensitive benchmark flake (passes in isolation). PR #238 MERGEABLE (stacked, base = fix/c11-132-browser-portal-geometry-sync).
PR note: #238 was auto-closed when its stacked base branch was deleted on #237's merge; replacement PR #240 (identical content, base=main) opened and MERGED to main 2026-06-12T21:41Z.

MERGED to main: PR #240 (https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/240; replaced stacked #238 which auto-closed when #237's branch was deleted). Delivered, all in BrowserWindowPortal.swift: (1) per-slot hosted-inspector divider candidate cache with negative-result caching, invalidated on slot subview changes / slot removal / reapply paths, positive hits cheaply revalidated; (2) pointer-event gating in WindowBrowserHostView.hitTest mirroring the terminal host; (3) updateDividerCursor contract fix eliminating a hidden double-scan per pointer event in the no-inspector case; (4) branch-pruned candidate collection replacing materialize-all-descendants+filter; (5) browser.inspectorScan portal-log event for direct observability of real scans. Validation: 120 real HID pointer moves across 4 panes after forced invalidation -> exactly 4 scans (one per slot) then silence, vs ~240 pre-change; DevTools churn re-scans once per slot; c11-logic 911 green. Recorded gap: attached-inspector divider drag dormant on current WebKit (DevTools opens detached for portal-hosted webviews even via attach() SPI) — adjacent bug filed as C11-135. Evidence in notes/browser-freeze-triage-20260612/c11-133-pointer-storm-validation.log.
